title: Gummy and fractal chess: approved playable milestone
status: Approved P0 → G1 → G2 → G5 sequence implemented and verified on the working branch. The next review is hands-on local play, followed by measured tablet performance.
objective: Turn the published gummy chess showcase into a playable local chess experience, retaining the creator and cinema paths.
horizon: Approved P0/G1/G2/G5 delivery, with remaining candidates visible for later prioritization
master_plan_reconciliation: The 2026-09-30 concept status and initial gap list are historical. Six gummy roles, full board, capture rendering, repeatable cinema delivery, local legal chess and PGN/Cinema handoff now exist. Editable IFS role collections remain unfinished.
completed: Six gummy chess moulds and 32-piece presentation
Per-piece palettes, glass and lava board looks
MPM capture presentation with attacker retained on the destination
Portable shot recipes, fixed-time capture, native full-resolution export
24-second film and three shorts published by the user
Final films backed up in Proton archive and tweet folder

preservation.media: Current remote metadata verified; 369-file archive had a complete zero-difference download check on 2026-10-06. All four final films also exist under socials/personal/tweet.
preservation.code: Cinema checkpoint c4a08625 and lint-heap fix 0c8c8673 were verified on origin/feat/gummy-fracture. The local-match milestone is verified and follows as a separate commit on that branch; Git identifies its published revision.

effort_rubric.S: Contained established path plus focused verification
effort_rubric.M: Several connected components or one known integration
effort_rubric.L: Multiple subsystems and substantial state/validation work
effort_rubric.XL: Research, uncertain architecture or several milestones

estimate_scope: Relative judgments, not calendar promises. Includes integration and verification; target-device profiling is not yet measured.

matrix_grouping.impact: High goes to higher impact; Medium and Low go to lower immediate impact for the playable-local-chess objective. P0 is a prerequisite outside the feature quadrants.
matrix_grouping.effort: S and M go to lower relative effort; L and XL to higher. Boundary estimates keep their range visible and use the higher band conservatively.

parallel_discovery: A bounded G3 tablet measurement pass can proceed alongside the rules seam if the physical device is available. It does not justify speculative solver rewrites.
first_milestone: Verified: play legal moves, finish a gummy capture, replay/skip it, undo it, and return from PGN/Cinema with the same game and appearance settings.

alternate_objective.goal: Produce more promotional shots with less manual assembly
alternate_objective.note: The existing image quality and native export are already delivered; prioritization changes with the goal.

candidates.title: Preserve the current code on origin
candidates.current_state: Complete: checkpoint c4a08625 and lint follow-up 0c8c8673 committed and pushed to origin/feat/gummy-fracture.
candidates.outcome: Make the working source reproducible separately from the media archive.
acceptance: User authorized the recommended sequence and checkpoint preservation.
Scoped current work committed as c4a08625; lint-heap follow-up committed as 0c8c8673.
Working branch pushed to origin successfully; large generated media remains in the existing archive.
candidates.uncertainty: Generated media remains in its existing Proton archive; source is preserved separately on origin.

candidates.title: Shared chess rules and move receipts
candidates.current_state: Implemented and verified: chess.js 1.4.0 BSD-2-Clause adapter; 35 focused rules/FEN/receipt/PGN tests pass.
candidates.outcome: Provide one authoritative chess state reusable by the board, replay and cinema.
acceptance: Maintained rules dependency reviewed and exact chess.js 1.4.0 installed in core.
Retain complete FEN state, stable piece IDs and before/after move receipts.
Verify normal moves, king safety, castling, en passant, promotion and terminal states.
candidates.uncertainty: The separate Cinema validator is preserved. Current-position draw claims are implemented; declared-next-move claims and exhaustive geometric dead-position proofs are outside this slice.

candidates.title: Playable local gummy chess
candidates.current_state: Implemented and verified at /gummy?view=match: local play, legal destinations, special moves, presets, skip/replay/undo and validated session recovery. Native hardware browser flow passes; physical tablet testing remains separate.
candidates.outcome: Play a short local game, capture a piece, skip or replay the effect, and continue.
acceptance: Legal selection and alternating turns work from a starting position or loaded FEN.
Rules commit each move once, independently of animation or GPU failure.
Full playback and Skip reach the identical post-move position; Undo restores the prior position.
Special moves have explicit presentation semantics and kings are never captured.
The next player can move after the effect; a move receipt can open in Cinema.
candidates.uncertainty: The new UI and renderer require final combined checks and hardware review. Physical iOS/tablet behavior and frame cost remain unverified. Only ordinary captures use the crush presentation; special moves have lightweight animations.

candidates.title: Physical tablet performance pass
candidates.outcome: Keep interaction responsive with a measured cost budget.
acceptance: Measure solver, surface generation, lighting and recording separately on the actual target tablet.
Keep a replayable before/after capture with visual quality checks.
Change the demonstrated bottleneck and expose a low-cost live setting.
candidates.uncertainty: A bounded measurement-only first slice is S. Hardware access is required; no speedup is promised before profiling.

candidates.title: Named shot library
candidates.outcome: Save, name, duplicate and reopen a Cinema recipe without juggling JSON files.
acceptance: A saved shot restores position, move, material, colours, board and camera after reload.
Malformed imports and name conflicts preserve existing saved data.
candidates.uncertainty: This first slice excludes a batch queue and continuous multi-move simulation.

candidates.title: PGN to replay and Cinema
candidates.current_state: Implemented and verified: bounded mainline PGN import/export, history stepping, full setup FEN and reloadable ordinary capture handoff to Cinema.
candidates.outcome: Turn a real game into selectable capture shots.
acceptance: Import a mainline game and step its positions correctly.
Select a capture and create a valid Cinema recipe.
State support for variations and special moves explicitly.
candidates.uncertainty: Comments and side variations are omitted. En-passant and promotion captures remain legal in the match but have no Cinema handoff. External PGN resignation/agreed-draw results remain metadata, while game status and export result are rule-derived.

candidates.title: Sound in studio and native export
candidates.current_state: Approved stems and external mixer exist; browser exports are silent
candidates.outcome: Hear selected candy sounds in preview and include them in the downloaded movie.
acceptance: Preview uses timeline cues with volume and mute controls.
Export muxes audio against fixed frame timestamps.
Unsupported browser codecs produce an explicit supported fallback.
candidates.uncertainty: Audio timing, seeking and codec capabilities need verification. More paid sound generation is unnecessary for this slice.

candidates.title: Thinner necks and smoother small debris
candidates.current_state: MPM and marching cubes work; detached masses still look bead-like
candidates.outcome: Improve the material response during separation while keeping a fixed performance budget.
acceptance: Compare matched pulls with controlled particle resolution, surface kernel and material settings.
Separate surface smoothing effects from physical separation changes.
Check volume loss, stability and frame cost alongside appearance.
candidates.uncertainty: Start with a bounded experiment; marching cubes alone cannot change the physical tearing law.

candidates.title: Editable IFS piece collection
candidates.current_state: Flame studies exist; editable six-role board collection is missing
candidates.outcome: Reconnect the chess game to the original fractal creator goal.
acceptance: First prove one edited pawn saves and reloads with recipe, seed, material, stable bounds and identity.
Place its immutable baked snapshot on the board and keep game-distance role readability.
Expand to six role templates only after the pawn path is accepted.
candidates.uncertainty: Point-cloud studies are not collision volumes; preserve gummy and glass variants while establishing a separate representation.

candidates.title: Camera and timing controls
candidates.current_state: Three scripted camera paths and eight-second clock exist
candidates.outcome: Allow a small camera offset, elevation and hold-time adjustment.
acceptance: Preserve automatic actor framing as the default.
Save controls in recipes and update exported timing and audio cues.
Check portrait and landscape framing at the new limits.
candidates.uncertainty: A timing edit affects the capture driver and external audio cues, not only a slider.

candidates.title: Extra palettes and ready-made looks
candidates.current_state: Per-piece palettes and board finishes already exist
candidates.outcome: Offer a few additional colour combinations using existing material controls.
acceptance: Looks preserve side and role readability in normal board views.
candidates.uncertainty: Useful for variety; limited improvement to playability or material behavior.

candidates.title: Simulate all 32 pieces continuously
candidates.current_state: Current cinema simulates only the victim
candidates.outcome: Explore a fully soft physical board after a playable game exists.
acceptance: Define an actual gameplay need and a hardware budget before implementation.
candidates.uncertainty: Much higher physics/contact/memory cost without being necessary for legal chess or capture animation.

candidates.title: Online ranked multiplayer
candidates.current_state: Local match implemented and verified; online networking remains unimplemented.
candidates.outcome: Support remote competitive play after the local state contract is stable.
acceptance: Scope networking, recovery, authoritative state and service ownership separately.
candidates.uncertainty: Adds infrastructure and synchronization before the core local game has been accepted.

candidates.title: More accurate piece optics
candidates.current_state: Glass board refraction and approximate piece caustics exist
candidates.outcome: Improve coloured transmission and light occlusion on one frozen glass-board shot.
acceptance: Compare thickness and multiple-interval treatment under fixed exposure and geometry.
Measure the added live rendering cost.
candidates.uncertainty: Start with bounded optical improvements; a full path tracer is a separate research/production choice.

candidates.title: Fractal fragments retaining recursive structure
candidates.current_state: Research proposal; no finite connectivity model proved
candidates.outcome: Prove one Menger rook and a coherent repeatable local fracture.
acceptance: Use a finite representation with sample ownership and actual connectivity.
Keep recursive chunks readable through a repeatable impact.
candidates.uncertainty: IFS addresses alone are not physical bonds. This is separate from gummy MPM and should remain an explicit experiment.

implementation_in_review: G1: pure chess.js 1.4.0 adapter, immutable move receipts, stable piece IDs and complete FEN
G2: local two-player match at /gummy?view=match, legal selection, special moves, skip/replay/undo and tab-session recovery
G5: bounded mainline PGN import/export, history stepping and ordinary capture handoff to Cinema

verification.core: 35 focused chess adapter tests, core TypeScript and scoped ESLint passed.
verification.integration: 105 focused app tests pass. Native Chromium on AMD RDNA-4 verified 32-piece idle rendering, touch moves, full capture completion, replay/skip/undo, PGN/Cinema reload and return, and reachable controls at 1440, 834 and 390px widths. No runtime/GPU errors or Solid owner warnings.
verification.physical_devices: New playable match has not yet been verified on physical iOS or target tablets; earlier workbench results do not establish this.
verification.remote_scope: Only the P0 checkpoint is confirmed pushed here. Do not infer publication of the new match source.
